As this is a service acquisition, the Small Business Administration and the Federal Acquisition Regulation have a Limitations on Subcontracting requirement. Brief Description of Services

The VA Palo Alto Health Care System (VAPAHCS) has a requirement for Dry-type fire suppression system maintenance and testing of Grease hoods, exhaust fans and chemical Hazmat Sheds. The Government is seeking only qualified kitchen exhaust cleaning specialists who hold current certification through the International Kitchen Exhaust Cleaning Association (IKECA) or an equivalent recognized industry association. Vendors must provide documentation demonstrating compliance with applicable NFPA standards, including NFPA 72 and 96, and furnish all required qualifications, training records, and certifications for personnel performing kitchen exhaust and grease hood cleaning services.

General
This is a non-personal services contract to provide Dry-Type Fire Suppression System services for the VA Palo Alto Health Care System (VAPAHCS).  The Government shall not exercise any supervision or control over the contract service providers performing the services herein.  Such contract service providers shall be accountable solely to the Contractor who, in turn is responsible to the Government.

Contractor Qualifications:

Contractor shall possess a California C-16 contractor license and be certified by the system manufacturer to service and repair Ansul and related Automatic Fire Control Systems, or provide documentation of equivalent system training. Grease hood cleaning shall be performed by International Kitchen Exhaust Cleaning Association (IKECA)-certified or equivalent association Certified Exhaust Cleaning Specialists (CECS), or personnel who can document compliance with all applicable NFPA 72 and NFPA 96 grease hood cleaning qualification and certification requirements. The Government reserves the right to request and review such licenses, certifications, and supporting documentation at any time during the contract period.

Preventative Maintenance and Testing

Contractor shall provide all tools, materials, equipment, labor, and transportation to perform annual and semi-annual cleaning and fire protection services/ certification of the following grease hoods, exhaust fans, and chemical storage sheds at three divisions of the Veterans Administration Palo Alto Health Care System (VAPAHCS). All cleaning shall be done in accordance with NFPA 96 latest edition. All fire protection service/inspections and certifications shall be performed per NFPA 17A, 96, 10 and 72 latest editions.
